content.title: About
content.content: Dry barley cereal for toddlers (Baby Toddler cereal, barley, dry) is designed for children from 6 months old. The cereal is made from whole barley that has been heat‑treated, without added sugar, salt, or artificial flavors. It dissolves easily in warm water or milk, creating a smooth, easily digestible porridge.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Barley is one of the oldest cultivated grains, grown for over 10,000 years.
Dry infant cereals are convenient to store and transport and do not require refrigeration.
Barley contains beta‑glucans, which support the immune system.
The product is processed to keep gluten levels within safe limits for young children.
Only whole‑grain material is used, with no additives, making it hypoallergenic.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps develop a balanced gut microbiome in toddlers.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Barley provides thiamine, riboflavin, and niacin, which are essential for energy metabolism and nervous system development.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron is necessary for hemoglobin formation and maintaining energy levels in children.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: The absence of added sugar helps establish healthy taste preferences early on.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Beta‑glucans in barley stimulate immune cells, aiding protection against infections.

items.title: Cereal allergy
items.content: Some children may be allergic to barley; monitor for reactions when first introduced.

items.title: Gluten sensitivity
items.content: Although gluten content is low, children with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity should avoid it.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: The dry product must be prepared to a smooth consistency; large particles can pose a choking risk for toddlers.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix 150 ml of warm (not hot) water or milk with the cereal, stir thoroughly, and let it sit for 2–3 minutes. Add more liquid if needed to reach the desired texture. The porridge can be enriched with fruit or vegetable puree.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. After opening, use within 30 days. Discard if any off‑odor, mold, or discoloration appears.
